project_type: Python ML project (commit message generation) with a TypeScript VS Code extension frontend
language: Python (ML backend, CLI, scripts), TypeScript (VS Code extension)
build_system: Python: setuptools via pyproject.toml, install with 'uv pip install -e .' or 'pip install -e .'. TypeScript: npm in vscode-extension/, 'npm run compile' builds dist/. No Makefile.
test_framework: Python: unittest (stdlib only for test_postprocess.py; no pytest). TypeScript: mocha for unit tests, VS Code integration test runner.
build_command: cd vscode-extension && npm run compile  (TypeScript only; Python has no separate build step)
test_command: python -m unittest tests.test_postprocess  (Python tests). npm run test:unit in vscode-extension/ (TypeScript tests).
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'python -m unittest tests.test_postprocess' from workspace root — must pass 1 test. 2. For evaluation scripts run 'python scripts/evaluate.py --no-adapter --test-file data/processed/test.jsonl --limit 10' and verify it prints METEOR, valid-format, per-type breakdown, and creates type_confusion_matrix.png. 3. For notebook changes, open in Jupyter and run with LIMIT_PER_SPLIT=200 to verify output schema unchanged.
environment_constraints: System Python is 3.11.4 (bare venv with only pip/setuptools). pyproject.toml targets Python >=3.12,<3.13. ML packages (torch, transformers, peft, bitsandbytes, evaluate, sacrebleu, rouge-score) are NOT installed in the current environment — cannot run actual model inference or full evaluation. Can run unit tests (stdlib only) and syntax/import checks. Do NOT download model checkpoints or datasets. Do NOT start Ollama or llama-server.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify CommitSuite/ (read-only reference). Do NOT commit or push. Preserve commit-model-lora/ and data/processed/test.jsonl. Keep Python and TypeScript prompt logic in sync (diff_utils.py and vscode-extension/src/prompt.ts must produce identical prompts).
directory_structure: OffHand/ root: pyproject.toml (Python pkg), README.md, results.md, plan.md, MVP.md. src/commit_model/: Python package (cli.py, engine.py, diff_utils.py, postprocess.py). scripts/: evaluate.py, evaluate_ollama.py, install_hook.sh. notebooks/: 6 Jupyter notebooks (filter->train->eval->merge->quantize->eval_quantized pipeline). vscode-extension/: TypeScript extension source, tests, package.json. data/processed/: test.jsonl (9704 rows, NEVER modify). commit-model-lora/: LoRA adapter weights (adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors, tokenizer files). tests/: test_postprocess.py. CommitSuite/: read-only reference — CMG_eval_traditional_metrics.py, Ten-category_eval.py, CMG_eval_binary_metrics.py, Ten-category_eval.py, CMG-eval_dataset/, Ten-category-eval_dataset/, all_data/.
